heading.en: Counting field lines through a surface
heading.kn: ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುವ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳ ಎಣಿಕೆ

hook.en: Wrap any closed bag around a charge. Whatever its shape or size, the same number of field lines comes out of it. That simple idea is Gauss's law.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಆವೇಶದ ಸುತ್ತ ಯಾವುದೇ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಚೀಲವನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತಿ. ಅದರ ಆಕಾರ ಅಥವಾ ಗಾತ್ರ ಏನೇ ಇರಲಿ, ಹೊರಬರುವ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಒಂದೇ. ಇದೇ ಗಾಸ್ ನಿಯಮ.

objectives.en: Find the electric flux through a surface.
State Gauss's law and use it for a line charge, a plane sheet and a spherical shell.

narration.en: Wrap any closed bag around a charge. Whatever its shape or size, the same number of field lines comes out of it. That simple idea is Gauss's law.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಆವೇಶದ ಸುತ್ತ ಯಾವುದೇ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಚೀಲವನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತಿ. ಅದರ ಆಕಾರ ಅಥವಾ ಗಾತ್ರ ಏನೇ ಇರಲಿ, ಹೊರಬರುವ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಒಂದೇ. ಇದೇ ಗಾಸ್ ನಿಯಮ.

body.en: Electric flux through a small area is $\Delta\Phi = \vec E\cdot\Delta\vec S = E\,\Delta S\cos\theta$, θ being the angle between E and the outward normal (unit N m² C⁻¹). Gauss's law: the total flux out of any closed surface equals the net charge enclosed divided by ε₀. Charges outside the surface give zero net flux, and the shape of the surface does not matter.
body.kn: ಅಭಿವಾಹ Φ = E ΔS cosθ. ಗಾಸ್ ನಿಯಮ: ಯಾವುದೇ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಭಿವಾಹ = ಒಳಗಿನ ಆವೇಶ / ε₀. ಹೊರಗಿನ ಆವೇಶಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಭಿವಾಹಕ್ಕೆ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Φ = EΔS cos θ; unit N m² C⁻¹

narration.en: Flux measures how much field passes through a surface: E times area times cos theta. Gauss's law says the total flux out of any closed surface equals the charge inside divided by epsilon nought.
narration.kn: ಅಭಿವಾಹ Φ = E ΔS cosθ. ಗಾಸ್ ನಿಯಮ: ಯಾವುದೇ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಭಿವಾಹ = ಒಳಗಿನ ಆವೇಶ / ε₀. ಹೊರಗಿನ ಆವೇಶಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಭಿವಾಹಕ್ಕೆ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: flux and Gauss's law

narration.en: Electric flux counts the field through an area: Φ = E A cos θ, where θ is between E and the normal. Gauss's law: the total flux out of any closed surface is the charge inside divided by ε₀. Pick a surface that fits the symmetry: a cylinder for a line charge, a pillbox for a plane sheet. For a charged spherical shell the field is zero inside and kq/r² outside, as if all the charge sat at the centre.

title.en: Gauss's law: only the charge inside counts
title.kn: ಗೌಸ್ ನಿಯಮ: ಒಳಗಿನ ಆವೇಶ ಮಾತ್ರ ಲೆಕ್ಕ

narration.en: Drag the centre of the closed Gaussian surface and change its size. The total flux through it is Φ = q(enclosed)/ε0, whatever its shape or size. A charge outside sends in as many field lines as go out, so it adds nothing. Charges in nC.

caption.en: Drag the centre of the closed Gaussian surface and change its size. The total flux through it is Φ = q(enclosed)/ε0, whatever its shape or size. A charge outside sends in as many field lines as go out, so it adds nothing. Charges in nC.
caption.kn: ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಗೌಸಿಯನ್ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಎಳೆದು ಗಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಿಸಿ. ಅದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಭಿವಾಹ Φ = q(ಒಳಗಿನ)/ε0, ಆಕಾರ, ಗಾತ್ರ ಏನೇ ಇರಲಿ. ಹೊರಗಿನ ಆವೇಶ ಎಷ್ಟು ರೇಖೆ ಒಳಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೋ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತವೆ; ಅದು ಏನೂ ಸೇರಿಸದು.

text.en: q inside = {qin} nC   Φ = {qin*112.94:1} N m²/C
text.kn: ಒಳಗಿನ q = {qin} nC   Φ = {qin*112.94:1} N m²/C

tryThis.en: Enclose only the +3 charge. Now make the surface bigger without taking in another charge. Does the flux change?
tryThis.kn: +3 ಆವೇಶ ಮಾತ್ರ ಆವರಿಸಿ. ಬೇರೆ ಆವೇಶ ಸೇರದಂತೆ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ದೊಡ್ಡದು ಮಾಡಿ. ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆಯೇ?

tryThis.en: Find a surface that holds charges but has zero total flux.
tryThis.kn: ಆವೇಶಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಶೂನ್ಯವಿರುವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಹುಡುಕಿ.

tryThis.en: Does a charge just outside the surface change the field on it? Does it change the flux?
tryThis.kn: ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಹೊರಗಿನ ಆವೇಶ ಅದರ ಮೇಲಿನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆಯೇ? ಅಭಿವಾಹ?

body.en: Choose a Gaussian surface on which E is constant and normal, so E comes out of the integral. Infinitely long line charge (λ per metre): cylinder, $E = \lambda/2\pi\varepsilon_0 r$. Infinite plane sheet (σ per m²): $E = \sigma/2\varepsilon_0$, the same at every distance. Thin spherical shell (charge q, radius R): outside, $E = kq/r^2$ as if all the charge were at the centre; inside, E = 0.
body.kn: ಸಮಮಿತ ಗಾಸ್ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಬಳಸಿ: ರೇಖಾ ಆವೇಶ E = λ/2πε₀r; ಸಮತಲ ಹಾಳೆ E = σ/2ε₀ (ದೂರವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸದು); ತೆಳು ಗೋಳೀಯ ಕವಚ: ಹೊರಗೆ kq/r², ಒಳಗೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

points.en: Plane sheet: E independent of distance

narration.en: Use a symmetric Gaussian surface. A long line charge gives lambda over two pi epsilon nought r. A plane sheet gives sigma over two epsilon nought at every distance. A thin shell acts like a point charge outside and has zero field inside.
narration.kn: ಸಮಮಿತ ಗಾಸ್ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಬಳಸಿ: ರೇಖಾ ಆವೇಶ E = λ/2πε₀r; ಸಮತಲ ಹಾಳೆ E = σ/2ε₀ (ದೂರವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸದು); ತೆಳು ಗೋಳೀಯ ಕವಚ: ಹೊರಗೆ kq/r², ಒಳಗೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

caption.en: Field of a thin spherical shell of charge q and radius R: zero inside, 9 × 10⁴ q/r² N/C outside (q in nC, r in cm). The flux through any closed surface around it is q/ε₀.

label.en: Flux through one face of a cube around q

tryThis.en: Move R: the field outside does not change at all; only where the jump happens moves.
Double q: the flux doubles, whatever the shape of the closed surface.
Set q = 8.85 nC (close to 9): the total flux is about 1000 N m²/C.

narration.en: Field of a thin spherical shell of charge q and radius R: zero inside, 9 × 10⁴ q/r² N/C outside (q in nC, r in cm). The flux through any closed surface around it is q/ε₀. Move R: the field outside does not change at all; only where the jump happens moves. Double q: the flux doubles, whatever the shape of the closed surface. Set q = 8.85 nC (close to 9): the total flux is about 1000 N m²/C.

problem.en: A charge of 8.85 μC is at the centre of a closed cube. Find the flux through the whole cube and through one face.

steps.en: Gauss's law: Φ = q/ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻⁶ / 8.85 × 10⁻¹² = 1 × 10⁶ N m² C⁻¹.
By symmetry all six faces share it equally.

answer.en: 1 × 10⁶ N m² C⁻¹ in total; about 1.67 × 10⁵ N m² C⁻¹ per face

problem.en: An infinitely long line charge has λ = 2 μC m⁻¹. Find the field 9 cm from it.

steps.en: E = 4 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹, directed radially outward.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. An infinitely long line charge has λ = 2 μC m⁻¹. Find the field 9 cm from it.

body.en: Charge q at the centre of a cube: each face carries q/6ε₀. Charge q at a corner: only one-eighth of the flux passes through the cube, q/8ε₀ in total, shared by the three far faces (q/24ε₀ each); the three faces touching the corner carry none.

narration.en: Cube shortcuts. Charge q at the centre of a cube: each face carries q/6ε₀. Charge q at a corner: only one-eighth of the flux passes through the cube, q/8ε₀ in total, shared by the three far faces (q/24ε₀ each); the three faces touching the corner carry none.

mnemonic.en: Centre → q/6ε₀ per face; corner → q/8ε₀ for the cube
